'''Mount Ison''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on the snow [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> It was the tallest in the [[North Ridge/Legends|North Ridge]] chain.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|337|Mount Ison}}</ref>
